numberInput.$description: v0.7 — Stepper-flanked numeric input. Reuses input.* shell tokens. This file owns the increment/decrement button surface, value typography (mono), and stepper-button divider rules.

stepper.$description: The minus / plus buttons that flank the numeric value. Inline inside the field shell; height matches input.height.*; width is intrinsic (icon + horizontal padding).

value.$description: Numeric value renders centered, mono, tabular numerics enabled.

type.$description: Mono with tnum/lnum on for ledger-aligned digits.

suffix.$description: Optional trailing addon (e.g. '%', 'lb', 'STD'). Uses the same role as input.foreground.addon for theming continuity.
